subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Bus Pass Management System
abstract: Students apply for a college bus pass online by choosing a route and stop, then pay the semester fee. The transport office approves requests and can print route-wise passenger lists for each bus. There are separate logins for students and the transport admin.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Alumni Connect Portal
abstract: A portal where alumni register with their batch, company and city so that current students can find mentors in the field they want to enter. Alumni can post job openings and the department can announce meetups.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Stock Price Prediction Using LSTM
abstract: Predicts the next day's closing price of NIFTY 50 stocks from the previous 60 days using an LSTM network. We compared it with a linear regression baseline. The LSTM had lower RMSE but still missed sudden drops after news events.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Handwritten Digit Recognition
abstract: A CNN trained on MNIST recognises digits drawn on a canvas in the browser. Test accuracy was 99.1%. We also tried an SVM on HOG features for comparison, which reached 97.8%.

subject: ML-PBL
title: SMS Spam Classifier
abstract: Classifies SMS messages as spam or not spam using TF-IDF features and a Multinomial Naive Bayes model trained on the UCI SMS Spam Collection. Spam precision was 97%. A small Flask page lets you paste a message and see the result.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: RFID Attendance System with Cloud Dashboard
abstract: Students tap their ID card on an RC522 RFID reader connected to a NodeMCU. Each tap is sent to Firebase with a timestamp and shows up on a web dashboard for the class teacher. Repeated taps within five minutes are ignored.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Smart Irrigation Using Soil Moisture Sensor
abstract: An Arduino reads a soil moisture sensor and switches the water pump through a relay when the soil gets dry. Readings and pump status go to the Blynk app over WiFi, so the farmer can also start or stop the pump from a phone.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Air Quality Monitoring with MQ-135
abstract: Measures CO2, smoke and ammonia levels with MQ-135 and MQ-7 gas sensors and uploads the readings to ThingSpeak every minute. A buzzer and a red LED warn when any reading crosses the safe limit.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Women Safety Device with GPS Tracking
abstract: A small wearable with a panic button. Pressing it twice sends an SMS with the live GPS location to three saved contacts and keeps sending updates every two minutes. Built with an Arduino Nano, a NEO-6M GPS and a SIM800L GSM module on a 3.7 V Li-ion cell.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Blood Bank Management System
abstract: Keeps records of donors, blood groups, donation dates and the stock in each blood bank. A donor can donate again only after 90 days, and the system blocks earlier entries. Hospitals raise requests and can see which bank has the units they need.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Department Library Book Tracker
abstract: Our department library was run from a register. We replaced it with a Tkinter desktop app on SQLite that records issue and return of books, lists overdue books and calculates the fine at Rs 2 per day.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Automatic Timetable Generator
abstract: Builds a clash-free weekly timetable from the subjects, faculty availability and rooms. It uses greedy allocation and backtracks when a slot cannot be filled. Every generated timetable is saved so the HOD can compare versions.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Face Recognition Based Attendance System
abstract: Detects faces from a webcam with Haar cascades and identifies students using the LBPH face recogniser. Recognised students are marked present in an Excel sheet along with the time. Works best in good light with students facing the camera.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Plant Leaf Disease Detection Using CNN
abstract: Identifies 15 diseases of tomato, potato and pepper plants from photos of leaves, using a CNN trained on the PlantVillage dataset. A farmer uploads a photo on the Flask web app and gets the disease name with a suggested remedy.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Fake News Detection
abstract: Detects fake news articles with TF-IDF features and a Passive Aggressive classifier trained on a Kaggle dataset. Accuracy was about 93%, but it struggles with satire and with news published after the dataset was collected.

subject: ML-PBL
title: House Price Prediction for Pune
abstract: Predicts flat prices in Pune from carpet area, number of bedrooms, locality and the age of the building. We scraped about 4,000 listings from property websites. Random forest gave the best R2 score of 0.86, ahead of linear regression and XGBoost.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Smart Parking Slot Detection Using IR Sensors
abstract: IR sensors at each parking slot detect whether a car is parked. The number of free slots is shown on an LCD at the gate and on a web page, so drivers know before they enter whether there is space.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: LPG Gas Leakage Detector with SMS Alert
abstract: Detects LPG leakage with an MQ-6 sensor, switches on an exhaust fan, turns the cylinder regulator off with a servo motor and sends an SMS alert to the owner.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Smart Dustbin with Fill Level Monitoring
abstract: An ultrasonic sensor under the lid measures how full the bin is, and the lid opens on its own when someone comes near. Each bin reports its fill level to a dashboard so housekeeping staff can plan which bins to empty first.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Canteen Pre-Order System
abstract: Students order food from the college canteen before the lunch break and collect it with a token number, which cuts the queue at the counter. Staff see orders sorted by pickup time, and daily sales reports come straight from the order history.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Contactless Attendance Using QR Codes
abstract: The teacher's screen shows a QR code that changes every 15 seconds. Students scan it from their phones to mark attendance, so a screenshot shared on WhatsApp stops working quickly. Attendance is stored per lecture and the monthly defaulter list is generated automatically.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Medical Store Inventory and Billing
abstract: Billing and stock software for a small pharmacy. It tracks batch numbers and expiry dates, warns 30 days before a batch expires, and suggests how much to reorder based on the previous month's sales.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: College Event Management Portal
abstract: Clubs create events, students register online, and volunteers check people in at the venue by scanning their registration ID. Seat limits and waiting lists are handled in the database. Organisers can export the participant list for certificates.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Diabetes Risk Prediction
abstract: Predicts whether a patient is likely to have diabetes from glucose, BMI, age, insulin and blood pressure readings (Pima Indians dataset). Zero values that were really missing data were filled with the median. We compared logistic regression, SVM and XGBoost.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Product Review Sentiment Analysis
abstract: Classifies Amazon product reviews as positive, negative or neutral. We started with VADER and then fine-tuned DistilBERT, which raised accuracy from 71% to 89% on our test set.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Driver Drowsiness Detection Using Eye Aspect Ratio
abstract: Uses dlib facial landmarks from a dashboard camera to compute the eye aspect ratio. If the driver's eyes stay closed for more than two seconds, a buzzer goes off. Yawning is also detected from how wide the mouth opens.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Traffic Sign Recognition
abstract: Classifies 43 kinds of traffic signs from the German GTSRB dataset with a CNN at 97% accuracy. We also tested it on photos of Indian road signs taken near campus, where accuracy dropped to 78% because some signs look different here.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Crop Recommendation from Soil Nutrients
abstract: Suggests which crop to grow from the soil's N, P and K values, pH, rainfall and temperature. A random forest was trained on a Kaggle dataset covering 22 crops. Farmers can type in the values printed on their soil health card.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Voice Controlled Home Automation
abstract: Lights and fans are switched with voice commands through Google Assistant, using IFTTT and Adafruit IO. An ESP32 drives a four-channel relay board, and the normal wall switches keep working when the internet is down.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Vehicle Accident Detection and Alert
abstract: An accelerometer detects a sudden impact or a rollover and the device sends the vehicle's GPS location by SMS to emergency contacts. The driver has 15 seconds to cancel the alert if it was a false alarm.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: IoT Weather Station
abstract: Measures temperature, humidity, pressure and rainfall using a DHT22, a BMP280 and a tipping bucket rain gauge. Readings are published over MQTT to a Node-RED dashboard. The station runs on a small solar panel and battery.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Hospital Appointment Booking
abstract: Patients book OPD appointments by department and doctor. Every doctor has fixed time slots and a slot cannot be booked twice. The receptionist marks no-shows, and doctors see the day's list along with notes from earlier visits.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Campus Placement Portal
abstract: Tracks the companies visiting campus, their eligibility rules (CGPA, active backlogs), student applications and round-wise results. The placement cell gets a dashboard with offers per branch and the highest and median packages.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Exam Seating Arrangement System
abstract: Allocates seats for end-semester exams so that students writing the same paper do not sit next to each other. It takes the exam timetable and room capacities as input and prints room-wise seating charts and door lists.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Online Voting System for Student Council
abstract: A web app for student council elections where each student logs in with their college ID and votes once. Results are shown only after the voting window closes.
review_note: Not approved. Council elections already run on the university election portal, and the proposal does not say how votes stay secret.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Lost and Found Portal
abstract: Students post things they lost or found on campus with a photo, place and date. Posts that might match are suggested by category and location. A post is closed once the owner collects the item from the security desk.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Heart Disease Prediction System
abstract: A web app that predicts heart disease from patient records using machine learning, with patient data stored in PostgreSQL.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Credit Card Fraud Detection
abstract: Detects fraudulent transactions in a heavily imbalanced dataset where only 0.17% of transactions are fraud. We used SMOTE to oversample the fraud class and compared random forest with isolation forest. We report precision and recall, because accuracy is misleading on this data.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Sign Language to Text Converter
abstract: Recognises static hand signs from the Indian Sign Language alphabet through a webcam, using MediaPipe hand landmarks and a small neural network, and types the letters on screen. It covers 24 letters; J and Z need hand movement and are not supported yet.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Automatic Plant Watering System with ESP32
abstract: Waters potted plants whenever the soil moisture drops below a level you set in the mobile app. Moisture readings and every watering event are logged, so you can see how often each plant actually needs water.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Patient Health Monitoring Using Pulse Oximeter
abstract: Reads heart rate and SpO2 from a MAX30100 sensor and body temperature from a DS18B20, and sends them to a dashboard the doctor can open on a phone. An alert is raised if SpO2 falls below 92% or the pulse goes above 120.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Driver Fatigue Alert System
abstract: A Raspberry Pi camera watches the driver's eyes and sounds an alarm if they stay shut for too long, and a small motor vibrates the seat. We tested it in a parked car at night using an IR camera module.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Campus Air Pollution Monitoring Network
abstract: Five sensor nodes placed around campus measure PM2.5, PM10 and CO and send readings over LoRa to a single gateway. The dashboard shows hourly averages for each location and compares them with AQI limits.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: College Library Management
abstract: Tracks books, members and loans for the college library with fines for late returns.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Shared Expense Tracker for Hostel Roommates
abstract: Roommates add shared expenses like groceries, electricity and the WiFi bill, and the app works out who owes whom with the fewest payments. Every expense keeps its split history, so disagreements can be checked later.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Gymkhana Sports Equipment Booking
abstract: Students book badminton and table tennis courts in one-hour slots and borrow equipment from the gymkhana. Anyone who keeps equipment for more than a day is blocked from new bookings until it is returned.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Cardiac Risk Estimation from Patient Vitals
abstract: Estimates the chance of a cardiac event using blood pressure, cholesterol and age readings collected at a clinic.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Smart Attendance Using Face Recognition
abstract: Marks classroom attendance automatically by recognising student faces from a camera feed.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Tomato Leaf Disease Classification on Mobile
abstract: Takes the leaf disease idea further so it runs on a phone without internet. We fine-tuned MobileNetV2 on the tomato classes of PlantVillage plus 600 photos we took at a farm near Junnar, then converted the model to TensorFlow Lite.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Resume Screening Using NLP
abstract: Ranks resumes against a job description using TF-IDF vectors and cosine similarity, and pulls out skills using a keyword list. Tested on 200 resumes from a Kaggle dataset covering 25 job categories.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Speech Emotion Recognition
abstract: Classifies the emotion in a short voice clip as happy, sad, angry, neutral or fearful. MFCC features go into a CNN-LSTM model trained on RAVDESS. Accuracy on actors the model had not heard before was 72%.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: IoT Parking Space Finder
abstract: Ultrasonic sensors on each slot report whether it is occupied, and a Flutter app shows a live map of free slots in the college parking. This extends the 2022-23 IR sensor parking project by adding the app and slot booking.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Smart Energy Meter with Bill Prediction
abstract: Measures voltage, current and energy use with a PZEM-004T module and shows live consumption on a phone. It predicts the month's electricity bill from the units used so far, using the MSEDCL residential tariff slabs.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Water Quality Monitoring for Hostel Tanks
abstract: Checks the pH, turbidity and TDS of drinking water in the hostel tanks and sends an alert when the water is unsafe. Readings are logged every 30 minutes, which also shows whether the filters are being serviced on time.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: ECE Lab Component Tracker
abstract: Issue and return system for lab components like Arduino boards and sensors, with stock limits and late fines.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Mess Meal Pre-Booking and Feedback
abstract: Hostel students choose the next day's meals from the mess menu by 9 pm, so the mess cooks the right quantity and wastes less food. Students can rate each meal, and the warden gets a weekly report of ratings and leftover food.

subject: DBMS-PBL
title: Placement Drive Tracker
abstract: Keeps a record of every company that comes for placements, which students are eligible, who applied and who cleared each round. The placement cell gets branch-wise statistics of offers and packages.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Automatic Classroom Attendance from CCTV Footage
abstract: Use the classroom CCTV camera that is already installed to detect and recognise students' faces during the first ten minutes of each lecture and mark attendance automatically. Faculty would get a daily list of absent students.

subject: ML-PBL
title: Predicting Students at Risk of Failing
abstract: Use attendance, internal assessment marks and assignment submission history to flag students who are likely to fail a subject, so mentors can meet them early in the semester. We plan to compare logistic regression with gradient boosting and explain each prediction with SHAP.

subject: IOT-PBL
title: Smart Water Tank Level Controller
abstract: Measures the water level in the overhead tank with a waterproof ultrasonic sensor, switches the pump off when the tank is full and on again when it drops below a quarter. Daily water use per building is logged.
